goal.original: Prove MPI-608 end to end with a live run carrying a LoRA in BOTH phases, which pairs with MPI-567's own live run + reuse round trip and closes both.
goal.summary: Both live gates are CLOSED. Fabio ran the flow on his own GPU and eleven dispatches carried two LoRA racks at once, read back off the engine's /history rather than taken on trust - MPI-608's last unproven claim, now recorded and the card moved to `validating`. Reuse round trip confirmed by him on two flows. Three things came out of the run that were not on anyone's list: the ControlNet ceiling was the real reason the flow ignored the drawing (re-swept, 0.5 -> 0.60), the flow was renamed "Scribble to Object" -> "Draw It In" including its workflow file, and a peer session reported that this card's two `preview`/`video` lines had held master's CI red for a day and eight pushes. All three are done. NOTHING IS COMMITTED.

completed: MPI-608 PROVEN END TO END, on Fabio's GPU, read off the app engine's /history (48188) rather than believed. Eleven consecutive dispatches carried BOTH racks with the right node class per phase: Input_Lora_Phase1_1 = MpiLoraModelClip with an SDXL LoRA at model 0.6 / clip 0.5, Input_Lora_Phase2_1 = MpiLoraModel with flux2-klein/styles/9b/Storybook at model 1. The NEGATIVE half is pinned the same day: an earlier run with nothing picked dispatched all twelve slots as lora_name=None, so the per-slot opt-in holds on live evidence too. Card moved doing/in-progress -> doing/validating.

THE FIRST ATTEMPT LOOKED LIKE A BUG AND WAS NOT - THE RACK IS KEYED BY MODEL ID, NOT BY SLOT. That run rendered with ILL_Anime while the project's only modelSettings entries were sdxl-realistic, klein-9b and klein-4b, so the rack read empty and injected nothing, silently. Also found: G:/CubricModels/loras/sdxl/ was EMPTY (48 LoRAs installed, not one SDXL-family), so phase 1 had nothing correct to pick at all - sd_xl_offset_example-lora_1.0.safetensors was staged there, app route and ComfyUI both 48 -> 49 with no restart.
REUSE ROUND TRIP - PASSED. Fabio verified it on two different flows. That was MPI-567's Definition-of-Done item from 05-verify.md; with the live run above, both live gates on this card are closed.

CONTROLNET BAND RE-SWEPT, 0.5 -> 0.60 in both twins. 0.5 did not follow the drawing (he had to force the subject through the prompt); 0.65 overshot and put the doodle itself through; 0.60 is his call between them. end_percent stays 0.569, slider stays 0-1. It broke `flow-model-choice.test.cjs` - a guard that exists BECAUSE this flow diverged once before - and that was resolved as a NAMED, mutation-checked exception keyed by FILENAME, never a widened assertion.

THE JUSTIFICATION FOR THAT EXCEPTION IS THE PART TO KEEP, AND MY FIRST VERSION OF IT WAS WRONG. Not "edge map vs hand drawing". Fabio: 0.5 is the minimum safe ceiling across EVERY control type an SDXL card offers, and OPENPOSE and DEPTH are what set that floor - "passing 50 starts giving a lot of issues on open pose and depth". A t2i workflow puts all of them behind one slider so it must satisfy the weakest. This flow may exceed it because its graph CANNOT reach them: two banks only (hed/pidi/scribble/ted, canny/lineart/anime_lineart/mlsd) behind a two-option radio, no pose or depth preprocessor anywhere - swept and confirmed. That proof is now the documented bar for any future flow joining the exception list.

RENAMED "Scribble to Object" -> "DRAW IT IN" (Fabio). Display in flowsRegistry.js (title, description) and commandRegistry.js (label, and progressLabel which also said "object"), plus the doc H1. THE WORKFLOW FILE MOVED TOO: flow_scribble_object.json -> flow_draw_it_in.json, both twins by `git mv`, 18 references swept across flowsRegistry, universal_workflows, three test files, two docs, both research/lanpaint/*.py and this card's files.json. `git grep` over js/ tests/ docs/ comfy_workflows/ returns NONE.

THE id AND THE OP DELIBERATELY DID NOT MOVE - `scribble-object`, `flowScribObj`, and the doc's own filename. Cards already in galleries carry the FLOWSCRIBOBJ_ prefix and their sidecars' flowId. The workflow FILENAME was safe to move because nothing persists it: it is resolved per dispatch from the FlowDef's `workflow` field. Keep that distinction; it is the whole reason one half moved and the other did not.

CI WAS RED FOR A DAY AND EIGHT PUSHES AND IT WAS THIS CARD'S LINE. Peer message 38698ec8 (resolved) reported it; every claim was verified here first. preview/video were declared in 7c883d67 naming art that was never made, the tile fetched them and 404'd, and tests/desktop/flows-tab-ring.spec.js asserts consoleErrors is empty in three places. BOTH FIELDS DELETED, with a comment in the FlowDef naming the CI failure so nobody re-adds them before the art exists.

VERIFIED: node suite 728/728, desktop suite 26/26 (flows-tab-ring 4/4, the two that were failing), graph_parity.py PARITY OK, node --check + eslint clean on every touched JS file. Mutations RED both directions on the ceiling exception, files restored and sha256-verified each time.
pending: NOTHING IS COMMITTED, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE - READ THIS BEFORE YOU COMMIT ANYTHING. MPI-607's Voice Changer work is UNCOMMITTED in files this session also edited: js/data/flowsRegistry.js and js/data/commandRegistry.js both carry its FlowDef and op, and js/core/operationRegistry.js, js/data/modelConstants/universal_workflows.js, operation_registry.json, docs/playbooks/add-flow/{02-media-io,README}.md, docs/workflow-authoring/bench-editing.md and dev_configs/smoke-run.txt are theirs too, plus three untracked voice-changer files. `git commit --only <paths>` commits a path AS IT IS IN THE WORKING TREE, so it would sweep their half-finished flow in. .claude/rules/git.md SS Co-owned files is explicit that --only is the trap here and its own advice is to wait for the peer to land. Either wait, or use the filtered-patch recipe in that section.

A PRE-PUSH HOOK NOW REFUSES A PUSH WHILE MASTER IS RED - .husky/pre-push, added in b1ca2984, which is itself UNPUSHED (messages 38698ec8 + f48e282f, both resolved). It reads master's last COMPLETED CI run and blocks a push to master while that run is FAILING, printing `[pre-push] BLOCKED - master's last CI run FAILED.` Master IS red right now: the run for 3d2ccf2d failed on the same flow-scribble-object.webp 404, push nine on this break. THE PUSH CARRYING THIS SESSION'S FIX IS THE DOCUMENTED BYPASS: `git push --no-verify`. It is NOT GitHub branch protection (direct pushes to master still work) and it FAILS OPEN - no gh, no auth, no network or no run found and the push proceeds; it only ever blocks on an outright failure, never a cancelled or in-flight run. Once the fix lands green, nobody needs the flag. Push is user-authorized either way.

THE GRAPHICS ARE THE LAST REAL ITEM: /mpi-flow-graphics for the 4/5 tile still and the wide hero loop. Name them flow-draw-it-in.webp and flow-draw-it-in.mp4 - the display name, not the id (06 names them by hand). THEN, and only then, restore `preview` and `video` to the FlowDef; the comment sitting where they were says so. Re-run tests/desktop/flows-tab-ring.spec.js after restoring, because that is the test that catches a wrong filename.

THE SHADOW BUG IS FRAMING, NOT THE LORA, AND IT IS UNFIXED. Fabio's read was that a style LoRA suppressed the shadow; the graph record disproves it - 011 and 012 ran WITH a LoRA on the old prompt, 013 ran with NO LoRA on the SAME old prompt and was still not the good one, and 015 (the good one) is the only run with the new prompt. 013 is the control and it clears the LoRA. Mechanism: node #18 `Append Clean Background` bolts "...full object in frame, product shot, no scenery, no ground, no shadow" onto the render prompt, so the render is deliberately told to make no shadow and every shadow comes from the blend phase (#103, contact shading). Contact shading needs a contact point; "standing at the beach" gets framed cropped at the shins, no feet, nothing grounds. `full object in frame` is already in that suffix and is too weak to beat SDXL's portrait prior. THE FIX OFFERED AND NOT YET TAKEN: strengthen #18 so the flow stops requiring the user to know "full body far shot".

SHADOW DIRECTION IS A DIFFERENT AND KNOWN LIMIT - DO NOT CHASE IT BY PROMPTING. blending-into-a-photo.md already records that telling the model where the light is makes it WORSE, which is why the box step asks for room and never for light direction.

STILL OPEN FROM EARLIER SESSIONS, UNTOUCHED HERE: the box step's whole-image default, and the Output_Image SaveImage-vs-PreviewImage question that is Fabio's call (every other flow uses PreviewImage; SaveImage writes an extra copy into the engine's output dir that nothing collects).

MPI-608 IS AT `validating`, NOT `done`, ON PURPOSE. A live session is relocating the LoRA racks from the Flow Library slide-over to the flow's FINAL STAGE (Fabio's call after testing the character flow), and its file claim c608a1b2 is tagged MPI-608. Closing the card would strand them on a closed card. He considers the relocation a different agent's concern, not this card's.

key_decisions: THE NAME IS "DRAW IT IN", DISPLAY AND WORKFLOW FILE ONLY. id/op stay because sidecars persist them and reuse would break on every existing card; the workflow filename moved because nothing persists it.

0.60, NOT 0.65 AND NOT 0.5, AND THE REASON MATTERS MORE THAN THE NUMBER. The app-wide 0-0.5 ControlNet remap exists to protect OPENPOSE and DEPTH, which this graph cannot drive. Any future flow wanting its own ceiling must prove the same thing - the test says so.

DECLARING ART THAT DOES NOT EXIST IS A CI FAILURE, NOT A COSMETIC ONE. preview/video are optional and guarded; a declared-but-missing file 404s into the renderer console and flows-tab-ring.spec.js asserts that console is clean. Never declare them ahead of the asset.

A PEER'S REPORT IS EVIDENCE, NOT TRUTH - and this one was checked before acting (no such file in display/, three toHaveLength(0) assertions, the guard at MpiFlowLibrary.js ~333). It was right on every point.

MPI-608's UI IS MOVING (racks to the flow's final stage, another session). The injection chain is project.modelSettings -> loraPhases -> Lora_Phase<N>_<i> and does not care which component wrote the settings, so this session's end-to-end proof survives that relocation.
constraints: HEREDOCS ARE BLOCKED BY A GUARD HOOK and it fired twice this session, including on a plain `cat >> file << EOF` append. Write a .py/.js with the Write tool and run it by path, or use the Edit tool. `git commit -F <file>`.

MASTER MOVES UNDER YOU, FAST. HEAD advanced several commits mid-session (MPI-610 closed, MPI-613/614 created, a verify-workflow.mjs tooling script). A test failure that is not yours can also FIX ITSELF: shared-dep-uninstall-direction.test.cjs failed at 727/728, a peer committed the fix, and it passed on the next run without anything changing here.

A `git grep` THAT FINDS NOTHING EXITS 1, so a script using execFileSync to prove 'no references left' throws on SUCCESS. The rename script did exactly this and the throw looked like a failed rename; it was a clean one.

DO NOT RE-SERIALIZE THE raw/ TWIN WITH JSON.stringify. It collapses 1.0 -> 1 and 0.0 -> 0 across unrelated nodes - a 1-line change came out as a 26-line diff. Edit that file by line, surgically. (And `git checkout --` is hook-blocked, so recovering means `git show HEAD:<path>`, not a restore.)

THE NODE SUITE IS NOT THE CI GATE ON ITS OWN. npm test was 728/728 green for a day while master's CI was red, because the failure was in the DESKTOP suite (npm run test:desktop). Run both. The desktop suite takes its own free port and leaves a dev app on :3000 alone.
